rationale.skip: Not skipped — the change directly modifies FunctionsToolbar.vue, replacing the VRL/JS radio buttons with a segmented toggle group (OToggleGroup), adding language badges, per-option info tooltips, and a separator divider. This is a user-facing UI control change. No explicit skip label or comment is present (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty).
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted — the FunctionsToolbar.vue component underwent a significant UI control migration from OFormRadioGroup/ORadio to OFormToggleGroup/OToggleGroupItem. The new control introduces new visual elements (badges, pipe separator, per-option info tooltips with data-state='on|off' semantics) and new data-test selectors. A browser-based test is needed to verify the toggle selects the correct language, the selected state is exposed via data-state='on', both info tips are reachable, and the locked-language fallback works correctly.
